description: Preview the QA merge gate for merging a branch into the token's base branch. The gate re-checks only the key × language pairs the merge would change. Returns its mode (off / warn / block), whether it applies to this target, whether it would BLOCK the merge, and the error and warning counts with the issues. When blocked, merge_branch fails with qa_gate_blocked until the errors are fixed. Pass the strategy you will give merge_branch: the pairs differ per strategy (branch-changes checks only what changed on the branch, overwrite every key that differs from the base). Call it after run_qa and before asking the user to approve a merge.

branch.description: The branch you want to merge into the base (the source).

strategy.description: The merge strategy to preview (default overwrite) – the same one you will pass to merge_branch.

name: check_merge_gate
title: Check Merge Gate
